notes.title: Patch notes 10/26/20
notes.notes:
We have released a new version of UPPERS.
Build Number: 5730504

This update adds a DLL file that may be missing if Steam's first-time installation wasn't able to run properly:
OpenAL32.dll

notes.title: Patch notes 10/22/20
notes.notes:
We have released a new version of UPPERS.
Build Number: 5718637

This update addresses the following issues:
-Enemies become stuck in midair after being hit by another enemy during a throw.
-The camera becomes stuck when the player performs a Pole Action at the same time that Lucky L Defense is activated.
-Minor English text fixes.
